name: Devil, The Desire (Unique; 3pp)
body:
The Desire
CR 9

Her beauty masks only evil and villainy, an insatiable lust to break the titled, the noble and the powerful.

XP 6,400
NE medium outsider (devil, evil, native)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 14, flat-footed 14; (+3 armor, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural)
hp 56 (7d8+21)
Fort +7, Ref +8, Will +10
Defensive Abilities desire’s gift, false flattery, lover’s guardian; Immune charm, devil traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk envenomed dagger +6 (1d4+1 + giant wasp poison)
Spells Known (CL 7th)

3rd (3/day)—dispel magic, see invisibility
2nd (5/day)—blur, cat’s grace, eagle’s splendor, whispering winds
1st (6/day)—alarm, comprehend languages, cure light wounds, identify, unseen servant
0th (at will)—detect magic, ghost sound (DC 16), mage hand, message, open/close, resistance

Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th)

3/day—alter self, charm person (DC 17), suggestion (DC 19)
1/day—mass suggestion (DC 21)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 17, Wis 16, Cha 22
Base Atk +5; CMB +6; CMD 16
Feats Alertness, Dodge, Eschew Materials, Extra Performance, Great FortitudeB, Iron WillB, Leadership, Throw Anything
Skills Diplomacy +16, Knowledge (local, nobility) +13, Perception +15, Perform (act, dance, sing, stringed) +16, Sense Motive +15, Use Magical Device +16. From Bardic Versatile Performance: Acrobatics, Bluff, Disguise, Fly all +16.
Languages Common, Draconic, Elven, Infernal
SQ bardic abilities, beauty, honeyed words
Gear amulet of natural armor (+1), bracers of armor +3, other items as given by her lovers or acquired

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bardic Abilities

The Desire is a 7th level bard with the versatile performances of act and dance.

Beauty (Ex)

The Desire is exceptionally alluring, possessing unearthly beauty and charm, she gains a +2 circumstance bonus to all social rolls against those who find her attractive. When such a person would attack her, they must make a Will save (DC 19) or suffer a -1 moral penalty to all of their attack against her for the duration of the encounter.

Desire’s Gift (Su)

The Desire has full control over the magic items known as Desire’s Gifts, see the item for more details.

Honeyed Words (Su)

Given time, the Desire can worm her way into almost any heart. If she spends at least an hour a day in the company of a person for a week, the Desire gains a +4 competence bonus on all social skills and +2 to all of her abilities’ DC against that person for the next month.

Lover’s Guardian (Ex)

For each adjacent ally, the Desire gains a +1 circumstance bonus to armor class up to a maximum of +4 as they constantly move to protect her.

Lover’s Sacrifice (Su)

Once per round, as a free action, The Desire may switch places with one of her allies within 10′.

Associated Magic Item: Desire’s Gift

ECOLOGY

Environment urban
Organization unique
Treasure Value considerable

The Desire was originally created by “seaofstars” at http://seaofstarsrpg.wordpress.com/2009/12/14/the-desire-for-pathfinder/
